resources.string: Delete these saved settings? The observed LAN service will not be affected.
No matching saved devices. Add a device or change the search.
No matching observations. Refresh finds only supported advertised services, not every LAN device.
Manual IPv4 DNS-SD browse, up to 30 seconds. NSD may not provide a hostname; hardware type stays Unknown. No room authentication or port scan is performed.
Partial results: a platform, network or resource limit was reached.
Historical observation; current presence is not established.
Observed service; reachability and identity are unverified.
Review copied settings before saving. MAC and Wake-on-LAN are never inferred; saved and discovered records stay separate.
Choose Details on a device to view its settings or advertised services.
This record has left the current snapshot. Saved settings are unchanged.
Enter a MAC manually to enable Wake-on-LAN. An empty MAC removes WoL configuration. Android does not expose other devices’ MAC addresses.
No LAN IPv4 interfaces reported. Refresh after connecting Wi-Fi or Ethernet.
Broadcast capability is unknown or unavailable; WoL may be unsupported on this binding.
Checks one port at the first suitable resolved address. Refusal or timeout does not prove the device is offline. Connection time is not ICMP RTT.
System/default-network resolution and cache. Selecting a TCP source does not bind DNS to that network. API 26–28 native lookups may finish after cancellation.
Select a reported gateway and enter one TCP port. A working router may refuse this port; no ports are scanned.
Select an interface with an available IPv4 gateway to enable this check.
ICMP ping is unavailable. TCP, DNS and device power state are different observations.
Could not read valid saved settings. Changes are disabled. Repair the private device preferences and reload; existing data will not be overwritten.
Could not commit device settings. The original list and draft are retained. Retry or reload after an external change.
Enter a name of 1–128 characters without control characters.
Enter a valid IP address or hostname in its corresponding field.
Enter a valid nonzero unicast MAC address.
Enter an IPv4 broadcast address or leave the override empty.
Enter a timeout from 1 to 30000 ms.
Invalid network/device settings. Check the address, MAC, broadcast, port and source selection.
Select a source network explicitly when several LANs are available.
The selected network changed or is unavailable. Refresh and choose a current interface.
No usable LAN route is available. Check Wi-Fi/Ethernet and refresh.
The OS denied network access. Check permissions and retry.
The operation timed out; this does not establish device reachability or power state.
This TCP port did not accept a connection. The device may still be running.
No address was resolved for this input/filter. This does not prove the device is offline.
The tool is busy or a resource limit was reached. A native lookup or NSD cleanup may still be finishing; retry later.
Unsupported on this platform/network. Legacy NSD requires a single LAN without a VPN; scoped IPv6 and ICMP are unavailable.
The network operation failed. Check the input, interface and connection, then retry.
Nearby access is needed for device discovery. Grant permission when using Refresh; after denial, check app permissions in Settings and retry.
Browse completed; retained observations are historical, not online status.
Magic packet submitted to %1$s:%2$s. Delivery and physical wake-up are not confirmed.
TCP %1$s:%2$s accepted a connection in %3$s ms. This is not ICMP RTT or proof of power state.
Addresses for %1$s: %2$s. Lookup time: %3$s ms; system/cache answer, not connectivity evidence.
Numeric input %1$s: %2$s (%3$s ms). No DNS query was needed; connectivity was not checked.
Cancelled. A network attempt may already have reached its target; native lookup/NSD cleanup may still be finishing.
